title: Ib Kamara
tldr: `Creative Director` of Off-White `(Ex) Editor-in-Chief` of DAZED
info: IB Kamara는 시에라리온 출신, 런던 기반의 스타일리스트, 저널리스트, 음악가, 모델, 크리에이티브 디렉터다. 2021년 1월 Dazed 편집장에 임명되었고, Virgil Abloh가 2021년 11월 사망한 뒤 2024년 Off-White의 크리에이티브 디렉터로 발표되었다. IB Kamara, pronounced I.B. is a Sierra Leone-born, London-based stylist, journalist, musician, model and creative director. In January 2021, he was named editor-in-chief of Dazed magazine and in 2024 was announced as creative director for Off-White following the death of Virgil Abloh in November 2021.
